   674	def _uncertain_gap_event(root: Path, path: Path) -> JsonRow:
   675	    sequences: list[int] = []
   676	    diagnostic_errors: set[str] = set()
   677	    if path.suffix in {".jsonl", ".tmp"} or path.name.startswith("raw-control-"):
   678	        try:
   679	            with path.open("rb") as handle:
   680	                for line in handle:
   681	                    try:
   682	                        row = json.loads(line)
   683	                    except (ValueError, UnicodeError, RecursionError):
   684	                        diagnostic_errors.add("UNDECODABLE_OR_INVALID_JSON")
   685	                        continue
   686	                    if not isinstance(row, dict):
   687	                        diagnostic_errors.add("NON_OBJECT_JSON")
   688	                        continue
   689	                    value = row.get("ingest_sequence")
   690	                    if isinstance(value, int) and not isinstance(value, bool) and value >= 0:
   691	                        sequences.append(value)
   692	        except OSError:
   693	            diagnostic_errors.add("UNREADABLE_TAIL")
   694	    return {
   695	        "event_type": "UNCERTAIN_GAP",
   696	        "reason": "UNCOMMITTED_RAW_TAIL",
   697	        "path": _relative_path(root, path),
   698	        "first_ingest_sequence": min(sequences) if sequences else None,
   699	        "last_ingest_sequence": max(sequences) if sequences else None,
   700	        "diagnostic_errors": sorted(diagnostic_errors),
   701	    }
